parameters.content:
## W34 POPIA (lean, 20 Oct 2026)
Live tables only (CRM-NURTURE-SCHEMA.md D4/D5: dsr_requests, retention_log, obligations, smc_erase_lead and ops.* were dropped).
- **Nightly 02:30 SAST**: delete WhatsApp quiz threads past expires_at or 72 h after the last inbound (privacy notice: unfinished chats 72 h); anonymise SortMyCover leads whose `retention_delete_after` has passed and that were never routed or counted (W01 / W03 / W39 set it for non-fit and no-tap entries: privacy notice 24 h). Contact details, tracking ids and message text are cleared; the consent record and the answers stay. Each lead change is written to audit_log by the smc_audit trigger (personal values redacted) with source "W34 retention" and the reason.
- **DSR** (howzit@ mail with DSR wording, or POST /webhook/w34/dsr): one escalations row kind `dsr` (no name or contact) + a W22 alert to Jono. Access / erasure is handled by hand within 30 days (reply from howzit@).
- **Breach mail**: incidents draft + W22 (unchanged).
Not built (later, if needed): 12-month pseudonymisation after last contact, consent-record deletion at 5 years, a DSR clock.

parameters.query:
-- Unfinished WhatsApp quiz threads (privacy notice: 72 h). wa_threads holds only a mobile hash + quiz state.
WITH d AS (
  DELETE FROM public.wa_threads t
   WHERE t.expires_at < now() OR t.last_inbound_at < now() - interval '72 hours'
  RETURNING 1)
SELECT count(*)::int AS threads_deleted FROM d;

-- Non-fit / no-tap entries past leads.retention_delete_after (set by W01 / W03 / W39; cleared when a lead qualifies), never routed or counted.
-- Anonymise in place (POPIA s14: de-identify): contact, tracking ids, free text and message content go; the consent record and the
-- answers stay. smc_audit writes one audit_log row per lead (personal values redacted) with this source and reason.
WITH cfg AS (SELECT set_config('smc.source', 'W34 retention', true) AS s,
                    set_config('smc.reason', 'retention_delete_after passed (privacy notice, POPIA s14)', true) AS r),
l AS (
  UPDATE public.leads x
     SET first_name = NULL, last_name = NULL, phone = 'erased', email = NULL, alt_email = NULL, call_number = NULL, alt_number = NULL,
         address = NULL, company = NULL, role = NULL, notes = NULL, client_ip = NULL, client_user_agent = NULL,
         fbclid = NULL, fbp = NULL, fbc = NULL, ctwa_clid = NULL, wa_id = NULL, leadgen_id = NULL, page_url = NULL,
         conv_state = NULL, capture_state = NULL, dedupe_hash = NULL, email_verify_code_hash = NULL,
         retention_delete_after = NULL, updated_at = now()
    FROM cfg
   WHERE cfg.s IS NOT NULL AND cfg.r IS NOT NULL
     AND x.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND x.retention_delete_after < now()
     AND x.routed_at IS NULL AND x.lead_order_id IS NULL
  RETURNING x.id),
c AS (
  UPDATE public.communications m SET content = NULL, subject = NULL, recipient_contact = 'erased', metadata = '{}'::jsonb
   WHERE m.lead_id IN (SELECT id FROM l)
  RETURNING 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS leads_anonymised, (SELECT count(*) FROM c)::int AS messages_cleared;

nodes.name: howzit@ mailbox (DSR keywords)
nodes.notes: Same mailbox credential as W17. Read-only here: W34 never marks, moves or replies. Non-DSR mail (FNB, bounces, brokers) is dropped by the normaliser. Lane B2 (breach reports) reads the same trigger.

nodes.name: DSR intake (manual webhook)
nodes.notes: Console / IO posts {kind, channel, requester, contact, lead_id?, request_ref?, note?}. Portal form, WhatsApp "delete my details" and post are entered here.

nodes.name: Record DSR escalation (kind dsr, by hand)

parameters.query:
-- One open escalation per request (dedupe on the request ref within 30 days). No name or contact is stored: Jono reads the mail
-- in howzit@ (or the webhook caller's record) and answers by hand within 30 days.
INSERT INTO public.escalations (brand_id, kind, severity, ref_table, ref_id, lead_id, raised_at, note)
SELECT $1::uuid, 'dsr', 'urgent', 'dsr_request', $2, $3::uuid, now(), $4
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.escalations e WHERE e.kind = 'dsr' AND e.ref_id = $2 AND e.raised_at > now() - interval '30 days')
RETURNING id, ref_id;

nodes.name: Detect breach report (EN + AF keywords)
nodes.notes: G1 (breach drill P14). Reads the same howzit@ trigger as the DSR lane. Conservative whole-phrase list; the keyword set is documented in deliverables/compliance-qa/W34-popia-ops.md. Read-only on the mailbox.

parameters.query:
-- W34 B2: one incidents DRAFT row per breach-report e-mail (idempotent on the ref in the summary, so a re-poll never opens two).
-- severity high until a person assesses it; affected_count unknown (null). No sender name, address or message text is stored.
-- Existing table only (migration smc_03): the exposure window, data categories and notice wording have no columns yet (drill gap G5, platform-architect).
-- $1 detector item (json)
with v as (
  select * from jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) as v(ref text, received_at timestamptz, summary text)
), ins as (
  insert into public.incidents (declared_at, severity, summary)
  select v.received_at, 'high', v.summary from v
  where not exists (select 1 from public.incidents i where i.summary like '%(ref ' || v.ref || ')%')
  returning id
)
select (select id from ins limit 1) as incident_id, (select ref from v) as ref, not exists (select 1 from ins) as duplicate;

nodes.notes: W22 input: { kind: 'popia_breach', to: [both], severity: 'red', incident_id }. Producer contract W22.md section 3. No send here: W22 owns delivery and DRY_RUN.
